Name: DE-EstimatesCount
Description: Gets the count of estimates for the given filters.
Statement:
select	count(*) as [Count]
from 	Estimate est
            join WorkflowState wfs on wfs.Oid = est.WorkflowState
            join WorkflowStateType wst on wst.Oid = wfs.WorkflowStateType
where	wst.Status not in (1, 7) and
        (@ModifiedFrom is null or est.ModifiedOnUtc >= @ModifiedFrom) and
        (@EstimateId is null or est.Oid = @EstimateId) and
        (@EstimateNumber is null or est.Number = @EstimateNumber)
